capabilities: Expand and collapse bookmarked folders inline in the Bookmarks pane
Open files by click, Ctrl/Cmd+click, or middle-click
Drag and drop files and folders using Obsidian's native drag manager
Persist expanded folder and fold state across restarts
Sync ordering with the File Explorer sort order
extras: Requires Obsidian >= 1.13.0; works on desktop and mobile; makes no network requests. Major Obsidian updates may require plugin updates.
intentEvidence: Expand bookmarked folders directly inside Obsidian's Bookmarks pane
problem: The Bookmarks pane only lists bookmarked folders as links, so opening their contents requires jumping back to the File Explorer.
summary: Expands bookmarked folders inline in Obsidian's Bookmarks pane, letting you browse and open contents without switching to the File Explorer.
